note: An unclear request contains Ambiguous. Before taking paper or starting For item in order, use If Ambiguous IN Orders and Help. Niko replaces the heard orders with a clarification.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
IF ambiguous IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  HELP
END
FOR item IN heard orders
  TAKE UP
  IF tea IN item
    ITEM tea
  ELSE
    ITEM coffee
  END
  IF number IN item
    STORE var1 FROM number
    WRITE var1 sugar
  ELSE
    IF sugar IN item
      IF negation IN item
        WRITE 0 sugar
      ELSE
        WRITE 1 sugar
      END
    END
  END
  MOVE RIGHT 1
  DEPOSIT RIGHT
  MOVE LEFT 1
END
JUMP listen
